sources.title: GitHub - sw30labs/sulphur-2-base
sources.snippet: Local Apple Silicon project for SulphurAI/Sulphur-2-base, modeled after the Stable Audio 3 desktop project. It wraps the native MLX LTX runtime with a small CLI, installer, and browser UI. This project does not vendor the huge model files. By default it points to: Video model: MLXBits/sulphur-2-distill-mlx-q4 Optional prompt enhancer: MLXBits/sulphur-promptenhancer-mlx-q8 Runtime: dgrauet/ltx ...

sources.title: Sulphur 2 Base — Uncensored Free AI Video Generation Model
sources.snippet: Sulphur 2 Base is a 9B parameter open-source AI video generation model supporting text-to-video and image-to-video. Run locally with ComfyUI. Free, uncensored, cinematic quality.
